rules.sectionReferenceMeaning: The accepted num citation label and explicit Niese milestones establish citations. Paragraph IDs are provenance only. VI has two chapter-only labels followed by section milestones; VIII has two continuing paragraphs; X's printed151 label is followed by explicit150. IX lacks51–109, which are declared missing without fabricated records.
rules.textTransformations: Exclude verified citation labels, source annotations, the six English omission notices, the IX lacuna notice, incipits, explicits and external metadata. Trim section-fragment edges and represent continuing paragraph boundaries by two newlines. Preserve every other source character and original word exactly.
rules.editorialMarkup: Retain add, del and unclear source content as searchable visible text with exact tags, attributes and clipped section spans in editorialMarks. Preserve accepted readings without silently correcting or completing them.
rules.transparentMarkup: Preserve corr, expan, s and ref text with exact source tags and attributes in sourceMarkup. Traverse recursively, including the unclear wrapper across X.199–200 with its nested expansion.
rules.structuralMarkup: Page, column and source-image markers contribute no characters or spaces. Only milestones with unit=niese establish citations. Preserve original marker attributes and paragraph coordinates.
rules.phraseBoundaries: VII.69–99 retain explicit zero-width TEI gaps and VII.100 starts after them. IX.51–109 have no records and IX.110 starts after the declared lacuna. X.108 is an empty source-defined interval without a TEI gap; X.108 and109 have breakBefore. Source ASCII dot clusters, Unicode ellipses and the two scraped punctuation spans in X.154 block phrase adjacency. Uncertain sentence punctuation in X.65 and75 remains ordinarily joinable. Continuing paragraphs and other consecutive sections join in whole-book scope.
rules.unknownContent: Unknown substantive markup, attributes, headings, notices, boundary exceptions or undeclared empty sections stop extraction for review.
rules.sourceProjectionDefinition: Every non-whitespace indexed character is original running source text. Each raw parsed paragraph is exactly restored from finished record slices plus recorded labels, notes and trimmed whitespace. Generated paragraph separators are whitespace only.
rules.offsetDefinition: Audit sourceText, flat and recordText offsets are zero-based Python Unicode-character offsets, end exclusive. Published editorialMarks, sourceMarkup, textGaps and phraseBreaks use JavaScript UTF-16 offsets.
rules.tokenCountDefinition: Unicode L/N start and L/M/N continuation, original word strings without normalization or stemming.
